settings.title: Spelling
settings.hint: Misspelled words get a wavy red underline in LordOS’s text fields; right-click one for suggestions. Checked on this computer, never online. Password, search and address fields aren’t checked.
settings.defaultHint: None chosen: your interface language and English, when their dictionaries are installed. Web apps use the same ones.
settings.chosenHint: A word is correct when any of the languages you chose knows it (at most 4). Web apps use your interface language and English.
settings.none: No dictionary is installed. Install one below.
settings.moreHint: Dictionaries from Debian. Installing one needs an administrator’s password.
settings.wordsHint: Words you added with “Add to dictionary”, here or in a web app.
